versions.k3s:
k3s version v1.37.1+k3s1 (356c0254)
go version go1.26.8

scope: Real trusted server process, PostgreSQL original-credential launch authorization, one-shot immutable Pod/guard/launch journals, K3s/gVisor/Chromium and live original process termination. No GUI control/observe grant; profile reservation remains held.
corrections: Bound Browser operator database-pool shutdown after canceled blocked queries.
Stage pause image through a verified mirror before starting the isolated K3s fixture.
Fixture API cleanup accepts already-absent original Pods only after physical readback.
Controller-loss state is reconciled at original arm expiry; historical Running is not health or action authority.
known_limits: Existing PreparedComputer/Volume/Candidate prerequisite in this integration fixture uses synthetic database evidence; no Workspace/CSI acceptance claim.
Fixed watchdog slice of at most 30 seconds, capped by original App expiry. No renewal, automatic queue adoption, or creation replay.
No GUI control epochs, action journal, observation publication or ComputerView; ready remains false and public Browser capability remains unsupported.
Volatile private profile only. Physical stop does not checkpoint, restore, release the profile slot, or authorize Computer stop/recovery.
Controller-death case includes actual transport closure and does not isolate EOF from watchdog expiry; separate node fault evidence is preserved in browser-runtime-2026-10-11.json.
Database stall uses a held organization stream lock, not a network partition or full database outage.
One disposable K3s node; no multi-node deployment certification.
qualitygate: Final unfiltered full delivery check uses existing line-ending policy; actual behavior evidence is separate above.
